agent.task: screens-divide - clicking Two keeps Three active; fix so Two links to itself and Three disappears
agent.outcome: landed - cause: Screen.sheet() baked the forward url once at build and Page.render() caches the view forever, so with Three open Two's box still pointed at /two/three/ - a click re-navigated to where you already were. Fix in screens/screen.js: sheet() checks at click time; if its target is already open (a prefix of the pathname) it navigates one segment UP to the box's own url.
